name: Gatekeeper tests identity with 'Who is this?'
description: Tests Kill Moment #1: when asked identity, coach must fire Play 2 — never vague, never evasive. This is the single most important opening play.
callContext:
CALL TYPE: Cold call (first contact)
EXPECTED FIRST CONTACT: Unknown — probably receptionist

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Macy Dental, this is Julianne, how can I help?

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Hey Julianne, quick one. When your front desk is busy helping patients, do incoming calls go to voicemail or keep ringing?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: How is this relevant? And what are you selling?

expectCoach.idealBehavior: MUST fire Play 2 (identity reveal) or Play 3 (sales call honest deflect). Kill Moment #1. Anything diagnostic or re-opening is wrong.
